messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I brought up the Zenith LoRA merge for customer Kestrel. Ran a small validation pack (200 ex) and seeing embedding alignment drop on role-switch prompts. sharing top-line numbers below.

jonathan: can you paste the exact metrics / snippet?

maria: sure — summary from the mini-pack run (merged vs baseline):
```
Eval summary (mini-pack, 200 examples)
Model: zenith-lora-merged-v1
Baseline: zenith-base-v2
Embedding cosine (avg): baseline 0.882 | merged 0.807
Turn-level role accuracy: baseline 94.1% | merged 86.3%
Perplexity (avg): baseline 18.4 | merged 19.7
Samples with role-flip hallucination: baseline 1.5% | merged 6.8%
```

sophie: hmm, 0.08 cosine delta is notable for role semantics. did you run the merge with token-map preservation?

maria: used merge-tool v0.9 with default flags; I accidentally left `--preserve-token-map` off when stitching LoRA. that could explain tokenizer drift. re-running with `--preserve-token-map` now.

alex: also check the int4 quantized variant used in staging — quantization + tokenmap shifts can amplify embedding drift.

maria: good call. re-running both: (1) merge with token-preserve, (2) int4 build on staging. triggered jobs.

eval-bot: kickoff: zenith-kestrel-retest-202304 | job_id=zk-4412 | started at 1761112800

maria: expected finish ~20m, will drop full diff + a few failure examples here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonathan: if drift remains after preserving token map, we should: 1) run the behavioral eval suite, 2) run KV-cache consistency tests, 3) compare hidden-state cosine across layers.

sophie: I can queue a hidden-state probe once you have merged artifacts. ping me when zk-4412 finishes.

maria: will do. logging the quicknotes into the onboarding doc after we confirm. thanks all. :thumbsup:
